rule: To authorize, change only this file: status REVIEWED_AND_AUTHORIZED, the owner grants Joe gives (EXECUTE_PROTECTED_ENGINE_COMPOSITION, CONSUME_PROTECTED_E_SEED_OR_FROZEN_RECORD_VALUES, READ_CURRENT_AND_FE516C1_SRC_APP_JSX), and each PENDING group to AUTHORIZED. HELD is allowed only for a group the inventory marks SPLIT_REQUIRED, and such a group can never be AUTHORIZED. Set authorizedBy to { ledger: "rebuild/DECISIONS.md", decisionsLine: <the DECISIONS line recording Joe's words>, ownerQuote: "<Joe's words, verbatim>" }; the runner checks only that it is present and well formed, the PM checks it against the ledger. Then pin this file's new sha256 as HOSTED20_AUTHORIZATION_SHA256 in the workflow. The inventory bytes and inventorySha256 do not change.
